subject: Kickoff: BUSTLE formula suggestion for data-platforms
body:
Hi all,

Kickoff for the BUSTLE effort. The research: a learned model guides a bottom-up program synthesis search to efficiently synthesize spreadsheet programs from input-output examples. The product: "write two example rows, get the formula" inside our data-platform tables - a genuinely sticky feature for the analyst persona.

Scope for Apr 6 - Jul 27:
- M1 (May 8): repro of the released system. Note the codebase is mostly Java (compile.sh pulls the jars) with Python/TensorFlow for model training - plan around that split.
- M2 (Jun 12): retrain the guidance model on an internal task distribution; benchmark on the SyGuS tasks (download script is in the repo) plus 200 tasks mined from our own users' formula history.
- M3 (Jul 20): latency-bounded prototype behind an internal flag - synthesis under 2s p95 for the demo set.

Saoirse is TL. Bao, over to you on staffing + the Q3 budget question we discussed.

Dmitri
